title: AI Code Generation with valid natural language prompt
description: Verify the system generates syntactically valid and functional HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files based on a well-formed natural language prompt using Google Gemini AI.

steps.description: Open the app and navigate to input section.
Set a valid Gemini AI API key and select an AI model in the settings modal.
Enter a natural language prompt describing a simple webpage (e.g., "Create a responsive portfolio website with three sections").
Submit the prompt for AI code generation.
Check streaming response from Google Gemini AI appears and completes without error.
Verify that generated files (HTML, CSS, JS) are saved into IndexedDB virtual file system.
Confirm loaded files appear correctly in Monaco editor's file explorer.
Validate generated code is syntactically correct and functional by running live preview without errors.

title: AI Code Generation error handling with empty prompt
description: Verify the system properly handles an empty natural language prompt input and shows relevant error notification.

steps.description: Open input section and leave the natural language prompt empty.
Submit the empty prompt.
Check that the system blocks submission and displays an error toast notification indicating that prompt cannot be empty.

title: Monaco Editor multi-file operations
description: Verify that the Monaco editor supports creating, renaming, and deleting files with proper UI updates.

steps.description: Open a project loaded in the Monaco editor.
Create a new file with valid name and extension (e.g., 'test.js').
Verify new file appears in the file explorer and is editable.
Rename the newly created file to another valid name (e.g., 'script.js').
Confirm file explorer updates with the new filename and code contents remain intact.
Delete the renamed file.
Verify the file is removed from the file explorer and storage.

title: Monaco Editor syntax highlighting accuracy
description: Verify syntax highlighting works correctly for HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files in the Monaco editor.

steps.description: Open files of type HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in the editor.
Check that keywords, tags, attributes, selectors, properties, and JS syntax are highlighted appropriately according to language rules.

title: Live preview updates reflect code changes immediately
description: Verify that any code changes in the Monaco editor update the live preview sandboxed iframe without delay or error.

steps.description: Open a project with multiple files in the Monaco editor.
Edit the HTML file by adding a visible element.
Confirm live preview instantly reflects the new element.
Edit CSS file to add styles to the new element.
Verify live preview updates styles immediately.
Modify JavaScript file to add interactive behavior.
Confirm live preview executes JavaScript and behavior is as expected.

title: IndexedDB Storage persistence and migration
description: Verify that project files and data persist across browser sessions and that storage migrations occur without data loss.

steps.description: Create and save a new project with multiple files.
Close the browser tab and re-open the app.
Check the previously saved project and files are loaded correctly from IndexedDB.
Trigger a version upgrade of IndexedDB schema (simulate migration).
Verify data integrity is maintained and project files load without corruption.

title: Settings modal saves and applies API key and AI model
description: Verify users can input, save and apply Gemini AI API keys and select AI models successfully in settings modal.

steps.description: Open settings modal.
Enter a valid AI API key.
Select an AI model from available options (free and paid).
Save the settings.
Confirm settings modal closes and selections persist on reopen.
Verify AI code generation uses the configured API key and model.

title: Theme system light, dark, and system modes
description: Verify that theme switching works smoothly between light, dark, and system preference modes with all UI elements adapting accordingly.

steps.description: Open theme settings or toggle theme switch.
Switch to light theme mode.
Check UI elements and backgrounds update to light theme colors smoothly.
Switch to dark theme mode.
Verify UI updates smoothly to dark theme colors.
Set theme to system default.
Confirm the UI changes adapt based on the operating system theme preference.

title: Toast notifications appear correctly on operations
description: Validate that toast notifications display appropriately for success, error, and informational messages with distinct styling.

steps.description: Trigger a successful operation (e.g., file save).
Confirm a success toast notification appears with correct message and disappears after timeout.
Trigger an error condition (e.g., AI generation failure due to invalid API key).
Check error toast notification appears with appropriate message and distinct styling.
Trigger an informational notification (e.g., auto-save complete).
Verify info toast appears with correct style and text.

title: AI Chat Interface conversational refinement
description: Verify the AI chat interface processes natural language user commands to modify code, fix bugs, and add features iteratively.

steps.description: Open AI chat interface.
Send a command asking to fix a bug in current code.
Confirm AI responds with suggested code changes.
Apply AI suggested changes.
Verify code editor updates and live preview reflects fixes.
Send a command to add a new feature or UI element.
Check AI suggests code additions and updates project files accordingly.

title: Mobile touch interactions reliability
description: Verify touch gestures (swipe-to-delete, long-press), haptic feedback, and other advanced interactions work correctly on supported mobile devices.

steps.description: Open project dashboard on mobile device or emulator.
Perform swipe-to-delete gesture on a project item.
Confirm project is deleted and haptic feedback is triggered.
Long-press a file in file explorer.
Verify long-press menu appears with expected options.

title: Voice command input triggers expected actions
description: Verify voice command input accurately recognizes English and Arabic commands and triggers the corresponding application actions.

steps.description: Activate voice command input.
Speak a supported command in English (e.g., 'Create new JavaScript file').
Confirm command is recognized and executed (new JS file created).
Repeat with a command in Arabic with equivalent meaning.
Verify command is recognized and appropriate action triggered.

title: Real-time sync and auto-save prevent data conflicts
description: Verify that auto-save with debounced writes and conflict resolution ensures no data corruption occurs during concurrent multi-tab edits.

steps.description: Open the same project in two different browser tabs.
Make conflicting edits to the same file from both tabs concurrently.
Confirm auto-save triggers debounced writes without data loss.
Verify conflict resolution correctly merges or prompts user with conflict dialogs.
Reload both tabs and check file contents for consistency.

title: Built-in code formatting enforces style rules on save
description: Verify that language-specific code formatting is applied consistently upon saving files in the Monaco editor.

steps.description: Open a project file (HTML, CSS, or JavaScript) and modify code with inconsistent formatting.
Save the file in the editor.
Check code is reformatted according to defined style rules automatically.

title: Project management: organize, filter, star, and search projects
description: Verify users can organize projects using categories, stars, filters, and perform advanced searches on the project dashboard effectively.

steps.description: Open project dashboard with multiple projects.
Apply category filters and verify only matching projects display.
Star a project and check that it is marked visually.
Use search input with partial project names or keywords.
Confirm project dashboard updates dynamically to show relevant results.

title: Security: verify Content Security Policy and iframe sandboxing
description: Ensure that the application enforces strict CSP headers and sandboxed iframe preview environment to prevent injection attacks and unauthorized script executions.

steps.description: Inspect HTTP response headers for Content Security Policies.
Verify CSP headers disable inline scripts, restrict sources properly, and allow sandboxed iframe usage.
Observe iframe preview element.
Check iframe has sandbox attributes set to isolate execution.
Attempt to inject unauthorized scripts via generated code.
Confirm the scripts do not execute outside the sandbox and no security breaches occur.

title: Cross-platform UI performance and responsiveness
description: Verify the application performs smoothly and UI adapts correctly across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices with no critical bugs.

steps.description: Access the application on desktop, tablet, and mobile environments.
Check that UI components resize and reorganize according to device type (responsive design).
Verify smooth scrolling, animations, and input responsiveness on all devices.
Test key features (code editor, live preview, project dashboard) and ensure no critical UI or functional bugs are present.
